notes.title: Build 0.1.1.8d is Live
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Just pushed out a small update with some minor tweaks:

- Sped up sunset speed in Sunset Beach, so users can relax under a starry sky
- Tweaked lighting/weather in all environments
- Random behind-the-scenes performance tweaks

The Namaste Team

notes.title: Build 0.1.1.8 is Live
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that Build 0.1.1.8 is now live.
With it comes new content in the form of four new classes, all of which are more optimized for virtual reality yoga.
There have been some minor tweaks to the lighting in Sunset Beach, as well as some behind-the-scenes optimizations.


- Added 2 Seated Chair Yoga classes
- Added 2 Yin Yoga Deep Stretch classes
- Tweaked lighting settings
- Added small, random optimizations

notes.title: Build 0.1.1.7 is Live
notes.notes:
Build 0.1.1.7 is now live with some bigger changes to the environments. All environments now feature a dynamic sky (moving sun and clouds). The Main Menu and the in-game menu have been reworked as well.

Patch notes:
- Added dynamic sky
- Changed in-game menu appearance - removed background
- Changed main menu environment

notes.title: Build 0.1.1.6 is Live
notes.notes:
Build 0.1.1.6 is now live. There have been some small changes, mainly to the way the classes are displayed.
Changes are as follows:

- Added ability to reposition main classroom screen
- Added picture-in-picture screen option
- Increased overall sound volume
- Updated user guide to explain new features
